== Template:Item/SpellScroll ==

Template for displaying spell scroll tooltips. Spell scrolls teach spells to characters.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon image filename
|-
| '''name''' || Yes || Spell scroll name
|-
| '''value''' || No || Item value in gold, or "Unsellable"
|-
| '''arcanist_level''' || No || Required level for Arcanist class
|-
| '''druid_level''' || No || Required level for Druid class
|-
| '''paladin_level''' || No || Required level for Paladin class
|-
| '''reaver_level''' || No || Required level for Reaver class
|-
| '''stormcaller_level''' || No || Required level for Stormcaller class
|-
| '''duelist_level''' || No || Required level for Windblade class
|-
| '''mana_cost''' || No || Mana cost to cast the spell
|-
| '''spell_type''' || No || Spell type (e.g., Damage, Heal, Buff)
|-
| '''spell_desc''' || No || Spell description
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/SpellScroll
|image=Spell Scroll: Magic Bolt.png
|name=Spell Scroll: Magic Bolt
|arcanist_level=1
|druid_level=
|duelist_level=
|paladin_level=
|stormcaller_level=1
|mana_cost=20
|spell_type=Damage
|spell_desc=Deals 25 magic damage to your target.
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/SpellScroll
|image=Spell Scroll: Magic Bolt.png
|name=Spell Scroll: Magic Bolt
|arcanist_level=1
|stormcaller_level=1
|mana_cost=20
|spell_type=Damage
|spell_desc=Deals 25 magic damage to your target.
}}
